title: 第7章 九天玄鸾第8章 三生武魂流光琴
slug: 斗罗穿成宁荣荣的妹妹一路成神
content_zh:
一步一步踏上了高台，其实心里忐忑，宁荣荣清楚她今后的命运，都在今天这一举了！
她抬头望着前面不远坐着的爸爸，还有剑爷爷、骨爷爷，给自己暗暗打气。
按照台上长老的话操作，随着魂力出现的，是一座流光溢彩的七宝琉璃塔出现在宁荣荣的手心，接着测试魂力，霎时魂力球青光大盛！
“这是……”
台上长老一脸震惊！
宁风致唰的一声站起，不少长老也纷纷站了起来，骨斗罗惊讶：“这是先天满魂力。”
“竟然是先天满魂力！”
其余长老都是一脸不可思议。
台上，长老出言：“宁荣荣，武魂七宝琉璃塔，先天满魂力！”
此话一出，全场哗然。
“天哪！
居然是先天满魂力！”
“不愧是宗主之女，就是不一样！”
“怎么可能？辅助系魂师怎么会有先天满魂力的？”
“啊啊……”
……
台下那些同样觉醒武魂的孩子，震惊有之，羡慕有之，嫉妒有之……而当事人宁荣荣则是满脸惊喜！
至于宁苒苒已经完全懵了——怎么回事？她明明记得原着中宁荣荣分明是魂力九级，并末达到先天满魂力啊？！
不会是因为她的出现，所以改变了宁荣荣的魂力吧？
宁荣荣下了高台，握住宁苒苒的手，比了个耶：“苒苒，到你了，别怕！

很容易的！”
宁荣荣怕妹妹有压力，小声的安慰。
宁苒苒哭笑不得，但是心里还是很感动的。
“下一位！”
台上长老喊道。
宁苒苒这才走上高台。
“小小姐不用害怕，闭上眼睛用心感受。”
长老爷爷和蔼的说，不过他并没有觉得宁苒苒的武魂会高过宁荣荣，毕竟先天满魂力百年难遇，更不要说双胞胎都是先天满魂力了！
“唰——”
璀璨流光在宁苒苒身后绽开，五光十色，衬得宁苒苒流光溢彩，宛若神女。
一只巨大的鸟自宁苒苒身后出现，双翼展开，鸟身宛若琉璃，流光溢彩，泛着冰蓝，浑身布满水晶般的翎羽，如同白雪般清透明亮，飞舞半空，似有翩翩雪花飞舞身周，长长的尾羽夹杂着银色纹路。
“这？这是……”
宁风致下首的一名长老站起，震惊：“这是冰凤凰？”
content_en:
Step by step, she stepped onto the high platform. In fact, she was feeling uneasy. Ning Rongrong knew that her future fate depended on this move today!
She looked up at her father, Grandpa Jian and Grandpa Bone, who were sitting not far in front of her, and encouraged herself secretly.
Following the words of the elder on the stage, as the soul power appeared, a gleaming Seven Treasures Glazed Tower appeared in the palm of Ning Rongrong's hand, and then the soul power was tested, and the soul power ball suddenly glowed with green light!
"This is..."
The elder on the stage looked shocked!
Ning Fengzhi stood up with a swish, and many elders also stood up. Bone Douluo was surprised: "This is innate full soul power."
"It turns out to be full of innate soul power!"
The other elders looked incredulous.
On the stage, the elder said: "Ning Rongrong, the Seven Treasures Glazed Tile Pagoda of Martial Soul, is full of innate soul power!"
As soon as these words came out, the whole place was in an uproar.
"Oh my God!
He is actually innately full of soul power! "
"As expected of the sect leader's daughter, she is just different!"
"How is it possible? How can an auxiliary soul master have innate soul power?"
"Ahh..."
…
The children in the audience who had also awakened their martial spirits were sometimes shocked, envious, and jealous... But the person involved, Ning Rongrong, was full of surprises!
As for Ning Ranran, she was completely confused - what happened? She clearly remembered that in the original work, Ning Rongrong was clearly at the ninth level of soul power, but had not yet reached the full innate soul power? !
Could it be that her appearance changed Ning Rongrong's soul power?
Ning Rongrong got off the high platform, held Ning Ranran's hand, and gestured: "Ranran, it's your turn, don't be afraid!
Very easy! "
Ning Rongrong was afraid that her sister would be under pressure, so she comforted her in a low voice.
Ning Ranran didn't know whether to laugh or cry, but she was still very moved in her heart.
"Next one!"
The elder on the stage shouted.
Ning Ranran then stepped onto the high platform.
"Don't be afraid, little lady. Close your eyes and feel with your heart."
The elder grandpa said kindly, but he did not think that Ning Ranran's martial spirit would be higher than Ning Rongrong. After all, it is rare to have full innate soul power in a hundred years, not to mention that both twins were born with full soul power!
"Shua——"
A bright stream of light bloomed behind Ning Ranran. It was colorful and made Ning Ranran shine like a goddess.
A huge bird appeared from behind Ning Ranran, with its wings spread out. The bird's body was like glass, shining with ice blue, and its body was covered with crystal-like feathers, as clear and bright as white snow. It was flying in the air, as if there were dancing snowflakes flying around it, and its long tail feathers were mixed with silver lines.
"This? This is..."
An elder standing next to Ning Fengzhi stood up and was shocked: "Is this an ice phoenix?"
